title: Symbiote Graph Layout Quality Report
description: Deterministic quality report for a settled 2D graph layout.

status.description: Overall audit outcome; incomplete takes precedence over fail and warn.

pass.description: True only when analysis is complete and has no objective failure.

complete.description: False when input, numeric representability, or deterministic coverage was incomplete.

inputBounds.description: Bounds must also satisfy x + width > x and y + height > y in IEEE-754 arithmetic; violations are reported as incomplete semantic findings.
